name: 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion → S&P 500 Peak & Drawdown
description: Analyzes each 2s/10s yield curve inversion event (T10Y2Y crosses below 0) and tracks the subsequent S&P 500 peak, the rally from inversion to peak, and the maximum drawdown from that peak. Uses SPY as the S&P 500 proxy with daily OHLCV. Forward windows: 504 trading days (~2yr) for peak, 756 (~3yr) for trough.
source:
# =============================================================================
# 2s/10s Yield Curve Inversion → S&P 500 Peak & Drawdown
# =============================================================================
# Detects each inversion event (T10Y2Y crosses below 0), then for each:
#   - Finds the subsequent SPY peak (max close in next 504 trading days)
#   - Computes rally from inversion price to that peak
#   - Finds the trough after the peak (min close in next 756 trading days)
#   - Computes max drawdown from peak to trough
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = study_assets()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# 2s/10s spread from FRED (daily)
spread_raw = economic_indicators(series_id="T10Y2Y")()
spread = ffill(spread_raw.result)

# --- Inversion Detection ---
# Inversion starts when spread crosses below 0
inv_start = crossunder(spread, 0)

# Inversion regime: stays inverted until spread crosses back above 0
in_inversion = hold_until(enter=spread < 0, exit=spread >= 0)

# --- Drawdown from All-Time High (for context chart) ---
# Expanding max of SPY close
cum_max = agg(close, AggregationType.Max)
drawdown = (close - cum_max) / cum_max

# --- Forward-Looking Peak & Trough per Inversion ---
# Rolling max of close over 504 bars, led by 504 = max of NEXT 504 bars
# agg(close, 504, Max) at bar t = max(close[t-503]..close[t])
# Leading by 504: at bar t we get max(close[t+1]..close[t+504])
fwd_peak = agg(close, 504, AggregationType.Max) << 504

# Rolling min of close over 756 bars, led by 756 = min of NEXT 756 bars
fwd_trough = agg(close, 756, AggregationType.Min) << 756

# --- Per-Inversion Metrics (emitted only at inversion start bars) ---
# Inversion date
inv_date = where(inv_start, ts)

# SPY price at inversion
inv_price = where(inv_start, close)

# Subsequent peak price (highest SPY in next ~2 years)
peak_at_inv = where(inv_start, fwd_peak)

# Rally from inversion to peak (as decimal for PercentFormat)
rally_to_peak = where(inv_start, (fwd_peak - close) / close)

# Max drawdown from peak: (trough - peak) / peak
# Trough is the lowest point in the 3 years after inversion
max_dd = where(inv_start, (fwd_trough - fwd_peak) / fwd_peak)

# Spread value at inversion
inv_spread_val = where(inv_start, spread)

# --- Visualization ---

# 1. CONTEXT: Yield curve spread with inversion shading
inv_band = where(in_inversion, 1, 0)

xy_lines(
    title='When Does the Yield Curve Invert?',
    y_axis_label='2s/10s Spread (%)',
    category='Yield Curve Inversion',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='2s/10s Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='Inverted', color=Color.Red, is_band=True)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=1
)(ts, spread, inv_band)

# 2. CONTEXT: SPY drawdown from all-time high
xy_lines(
    title='How Deep Is the Drawdown After Each Peak?',
    y_axis_label='Drawdown',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    category='Yield Curve Inversion',
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY Drawdown from ATH', color=Color.Blue)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.20, title='-20% Bear Market', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.10, title='-10% Correction', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=2
)(ts, drawdown)

# 3. EVENT MARKERS: Flag each inversion start on the TradingView chart
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='Yield Curve Inversion',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Date', type=CardRenderType.DateFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='SPY Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='Spread', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(ts, close, spread, inv_start)

# 4. REFERENCE TABLE: Per-inversion event summary
# Each row = one inversion event (Last agg on sparse where-filtered series)
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    category='Yield Curve Inversion',
    order=3,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Inversion Events: S&P 500 Peak & Subsequent Drawdown',
        row_size=1, col_size=5,
        col_headers=['Inversion Date', 'SPY at Inversion', 'Subsequent Peak', 'Rally to Peak', 'Max Drawdown from Peak'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.DateFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last,
                       type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1,
                       grid_color=Color.Red)
        ]
    )
)(inv_date, inv_price, peak_at_inv, rally_to_peak, max_dd)
